entities.name: N-(3-chloro-4-fluorophenyl)glycine
observations: Decoded first reactant: O=C(O)CNC1=CC(F)=CC(Cl)=C1, a carboxylic acid suitable for amide coupling.

entities.name: Chiral aminopiperidine heterocycle
observations: Decoded second reactant contains a secondary piperidine nitrogen and a chiral exocyclic amino substituent on a fused N-heteroaromatic system.

entities.name: Amide coupling of glycine acid
observations: The product is O=C(CNC1=CC(F)=CC(Cl)=C1)N1CCC[C@H](Nc2ncnc3[nH]ncc23)C1, consistent with acylation of the piperidine nitrogen by the glycine carboxyl group.
